name: Moodfit
one_liner: MoodFit is a mental health app combining mood tracking, CBT tools, gratitude journaling, and breathing exercises in one platform.
best_for: People wanting multiple mental health tools in one app
Those who like data-driven approaches to wellness
not_for: Those in crisis needing immediate care (call 988)
short_description: MoodFit is a mental health app combining mood tracking, CBT tools, gratitude journaling, and breathing exercises in one platform.
long_description: MoodFit brings together multiple mental health tools in one app: mood tracking with customizable factors, CBT-based thought exercises, gratitude journaling, breathing exercises, and goal setting. The app helps users understand their mental health patterns while providing evidence-based tools for improvement. MoodFit is designed to complement therapy or standalone self-help. The free version includes basic features; premium unlocks advanced analytics and tools. The all-in-one approach appeals to users who want comprehensive mental wellness support without multiple apps.
patient_summary: Moodfit is like having a mental health toolkit in your pocket. Track your mood, practice CBT techniques, journal about gratitude, and do breathing exercises. See how everything connects over time.

pricing.notes: Basic features free. Premium for full access.

privacy.notes: Consumer wellness app with reasonable privacy practices.

faqs.a: MoodFit includes mood tracking with customizable factors, CBT thought records, gratitude journaling, breathing exercises, meditation, goal tracking, and sleep logging. It's designed as an all-in-one mental wellness toolkit.
MoodFit has a free version with basic features. Premium (around $5/month) unlocks advanced analytics, additional exercises, and full feature access. The free version provides a good starting point.

MoodFit's tools are based on evidence-based approaches like CBT and gratitude practices. It's a self-help tool designed with clinical input. For diagnosable conditions, it should complement rather than replace professional treatment.

faqs.q: Can I share MoodFit data with my therapist?
faqs.a: Yes, MoodFit allows data export to share with healthcare providers. Therapists often find mood tracking data helpful for identifying patterns and adjusting treatment.
